items.text: Cincinnati: DE Cashius Howell placed on IR. TBD: CB DJ Turner II (ankle), S Kyle Dugger (quad), DE Cedric Johnson (ankle). TE Erick All Jr. (ACL) out for season; WR Andrei Iosivas (thumb, IR) likely back Week 10.

Atlanta (TBD): RB Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring), WR Zachariah Branch (hamstring, possible multi-game), LB Divine Deablo (forearm), DE Samson Ebukam (hamstring, possible multi-game), CB Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring). WR Drake London (head) returned in Week 8. DT Da'Shawn Hand on IR.
